sausages.description: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. These sausages should be boiled before eating.

bobsfoodtin.description: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. The tinned food that Bob sells is curiously popular in Galar.

bachsfoodtin.description: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. The tinned food that Bach sells is curiously popular in Galar.

tinofbeans.description: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. When simmered, the beans suffuse a dish with their mild flavor.

bread.description: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. An indispensable tool for mopping up that extra curry left on your plate.

pasta.description: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. These flour noodles make for a surprisingly good match with curry.

mixedmushrooms.description: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. The chewy texture of the mushrooms transforms any dish they’re added to.

smokepoketail.description: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. When a Slowpoke’s tail falls off, it grows back quickly.

largeleek.description: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. Whether this is the kind of vegetable stalk that Farfetch’d like is unknown.

fancyapple.description: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. An apple chosen above others. It has spectacular form and a brilliant sheen.

brittlebones.description: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. The taste boiled off from the bones is sure to give a dish a light umami taste.

packofpotatoes.description: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. Potatoes help mellow out a spicy taste, to make a dish more mild.

pungentroot.description: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. Though carelessly picked, these herbs can add a fragrant accent to a dish.

saladmix.description: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. The assortment of vegetables looks quite appealing and healthy.

friedfood.description: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. It’s been a while since it was fried, so it’s gotten greasy.

boiledegg.description: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. Even just one boiled egg can really enhance a dish.

fruitbunch.description: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. The syrupy fruits give off a strong tropical feel.

moomoocheese.description: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. Melted cheese can really give a curry some richness.

spicemix.description: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. There are over fifty spices contained within this ingredient’s hot flavor.

freshcream.description: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. Add some whipped cream to a spicy curry to give it some sweetness.

packagedcurry.description: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. Using packaged curry helps make sure there are no slipups when cooking.

coconutmilk.description: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. The refined sweetness of this coconut milk makes it quite popular.

instantnoodles.description: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. It has a junk-food sort of taste, but it goes well with curry.

precookedburger.description: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. If you’re unsure about what to cook, you can’t go wrong with some burger.

gigantamix.description: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. A mysterious spice. Even a tiny sprinkle is sure to make a curry gigantic.

baguette.description: A long loaf sliced into top and bottom halves. Its aroma of wheat and its straightforward, salty flavor make it pair well with all kinds of sandwich ingredients.

mayonnaise.description: A condiment that packs a very tart punch yet pairs well with various ingredients.

ketchup.description: A condiment with very salty and tart flavor. While a number of other ingredients go into its signature flavor, the noble tomato is its heart and soul.

mustard.description: A very spicy condiment that’s indispensable when bread is on the table. It pairs tremendously with ketchup.

butter.description: A condiment that unites salty and sweet and also packs a richness that makes bread a delight to eat. The finest butter products are made of 100 percent Moomoo Milk.

peanutbutter.description: A very sweet condiment. People in Paldea seem to favor the sweet varieties over the unsweetened.

chilisauce.description: A condiment with a very spicy kick. It’s thanks to Scovillain that this sauce gets its signature mouth- tingling burn.

salt.description: A very salty seasoning, unsurprisingly. People quite like the grains of salt that can be gathered from the footprints of particularly jagged Naclstack.

pepper.description: A seasoning packing very spicy flavor. It goes nicely with oilier foods and works especially well when you add just a pinch for a hint of flavor.

yogurt.description: A condiment that’s very sweet and very sour. It goes especially well with fruit and is easy to incorporate into a sandwich.

whippedcream.description: A very sweet condiment. Folks in Paldea seem to love the varieties that really let the sweetness sing.

creamcheese.description: A condiment offering very sweet and very tart flavor. It goes well with more ingredients than you’d expect, making it a convenient go-to.

jam.description: A condiment that’s very sweet and likewise very sour. Take care when adding it to sandwiches, as the sweet side can overwhelm.

marmalade.description: A condiment with sour and bitter notes. It’s surprisingly useful, as it makes a nice counterpoint to oilier foods.

oliveoil.description: A condiment offering faint notes of sour and bitter flavors. The most prized varieties are the ones Smoliv love the smell of—such oils’ quality is assured.

vinegar.description: A very sour condiment. Vinegars derived from grapes are popular in Paldea. Highly effective when used to add just a light note of flavor.

sweetherbamystica.description: A legendary condiment told of only in books. Word has it that one taste of its sweet flavor stimulates the digestive system and cures a lack of appetite.

saltyherbamystica.description: One of the condiments spoken of as legends. Its mellow saltiness is said to be tremendously effective when it comes to promoting health.

sourherbamystica.description: This surpassingly sour condiment is said to be super effective in helping the eater recover from exhaustion. Only a scant few people know it exists.

bitterherbamystica.description: A legendary condiment with a deeply bitter taste. It’s said to dramatically bolster a body’s immune defenses, though that hasn’t been proven.

spicyherbamystica.description: The legendary condiment said to have the mightiest of all spicy flavors. It’s said that a single bite will kick the metabolism into high gear immediately.

lettuce.description: This bitter-tasting ingredient is simple and straightforward—just add it to all kinds of other ingredients for a delightfully crunchy time.

tomato.description: This very tart ingredient has a lot of savory elements to it, making it popular with many Pokémon.

cherrytomatoes.description: A very tart ingredient. Some varieties are also very sweet, and these are prized above all others by the people of Paldea.

cucumber.description: A tart and bitter ingredient. Using it together with rich- tasting ingredients in a sandwich will really make the most of a cucumber’s fresh-veggie aroma.

pickle.description: This very sour ingredient is made by pickling veggies in a flavorful brine made from spices and vinegar.

onion.description: This spicy veggie is indispensable to many sandwiches. It goes well with rich ingredients.

redonion.description: An ingredient with some sweetness to it. Its spiciness and fragrance are milder than those of other onions, making it a pleasant bite.

greenbellpepper.description: An ingredient with some bitterness. When sliced, it adds a nice accent to a sandwich.

redbellpepper.description: An ingredient with some bitterness—but its bitter notes and overall flavor are pleasantly mild compared to its green cousin.

yellowbellpepper.description: An ingredient with some bitterness. It’s not much different from its red counterpart in flavor, but mixing the colors makes a feast for the eyes.

avocado.description: An ingredient with sweet notes—though its flavor is very mild. The avocado’s richness, however, makes it satisfying to eat.

bacon.description: This very salty ingredient has been cooked just shy of charred, making it burst with fragrance and tasty flavor.

ham.description: A very salty ingredient—and that very saltiness is what makes it such a nice companion to veggies.

prosciutto.description: This ingredient is very salty like regular ham, but the difference is prosciutto is not cooked after it is cured, giving it a fun freshness.

chorizo.description: A very salty and spicy ingredient. This type of sausage has particularly robust salty flavor, and the spicier varieties are extra popular.

herbedsausage.description: A very salty and bitter ingredient. The balance between the potent saltiness and the herbs’ bitterness make this sausage a pleasure.

hamburger.description: This very salty ingredient is the thing to add if you want to make your sandwich truly filling.

klawfstick.description: A very sweet and salty ingredient. It’s a nutritious processed food made with a concentrate derived from shed Klawf shells.

smokedfillet.description: A very salty and bitter ingredient with that unmistakable smoky flavor. It pairs exceptionally well with veggies.

friedfillet.description: When used in a sandwich, this very salty and bitter ingredient is at its best paired with sour seasonings.

egg.description: An ingredient with a touch of saltiness. It’s full of nutrients and can be enjoyed with all sorts of seasonings.

potatotortilla.description: A very salty ingredient and a popular dish in Paldea. It’s undeniably filling.

tofu.description: An ingredient with a touch of sweetness. It’s unclear how well this raw block of tofu will serve as a sandwich filling.

rice.description: An ingredient with a touch of sweetness. It’s unclear how well this cooked rice will serve as a sandwich filling.

noodles.description: A nice salty ingredient. It’s unclear how well these boiled noodles will serve as a sandwich filling.

potatosalad.description: This very tart ingredient—a soft salad that’s all about potatoes—pairs tremendously well with bread.

cheese.description: A very salty ingredient. This thinly sliced cheese is perfect for adding to a sandwich.

banana.description: A very sweet ingredient. This go-to fruit is sweet and rich, and it’s beloved by many Pokémon.

strawberry.description: A very tart and sweet ingredient, popular for its ability to make a sandwich visually striking.

apple.description: This very sweet ingredient is sliced thin to make it easy to add into a sandwich.

kiwi.description: A very tart ingredient that has a light touch of sweetness as well. It goes well with rich ingredients.

pineapple.description: This very tart ingredient is a fruit of southern lands, and its color and texture are a thrill. It’s been cut into chunks to be easily manageable.

jalapeno.description: A very spicy ingredient—so spicy as to leave no room for ambivalence about it. You either like it or you don’t.

horseradish.description: A very spicy condiment. Its distinctive sharp sizzle in your sinuses makes it a good match for rich fillings.

currypowder.description: A very spicy condiment. Just watch out—use too much of this potent seasoning, and it’ll cancel out the other flavors.

wasabi.description: This very spicy condiment seems close to horseradish at first, but you’ll find that it has a superb flavor all its own.

watercress.description: A very bitter ingredient that stands out among veggies for its quirky flavor. People tend to either like it or not like it—they rarely sit on the fence.

basil.description: A very bitter ingredient that’s quite versatile, as herbs go. It’s fragrant and goes well with tomatoes.

pokedoll.description: A doll that attracts the attention of Pokémon. It guarantees escape from any battle with wild Pokémon.

fluffytail.description: A toy that attracts the attention of Pokémon. It guarantees escape from any battle with wild Pokémon.

adamantorb.description: A brightly shining gem to be held by Dialga. It boosts the power of Dialga’s Dragon- and Steel-type moves.

lustrousorb.description: A beautifully shining gem to be held by Palkia. It boosts the power of Palkia’s Dragon- and Water-type moves.

brightpowder.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This glittery powder casts a tricky glare that lowers the accuracy of opposing Pokémon’s moves.

whiteherb.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It will restore any lowered stat in battle—but only once.

machobrace.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. Holding this stiff, heavy brace reduces a Pokémon’s Speed in battle but allows its stats to grow more quickly.

expshare.description: Turning on this special device will allow all the Pokémon on your team to share in Exp. Points gained.

quickclaw.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This light, sharp claw lets the holder move first occasionally.

soothebell.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. The comforting chime of this bell calms the holder, making it friendly.

mentalherb.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. The holder will be able to shake off move-binding effects to move freely— but only once.

choiceband.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This curious headband boosts the holder’s Attack stat but only allows the use of a single move.

kingsrock.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It may cause the target to flinch whenever the holder successfully inflicts damage on them with an attack.

silverpowder.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It’s a shiny silver powder that boosts the power of the holder’s Bug-type moves.

amuletcoin.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It doubles any prize money received as long as the holder joins the battle at least once.

cleansetag.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It helps keep wild Pokémon away when the holder is the head of the party.

souldew.description: A wondrous orb to be held by Latios or Latias. It boosts the power of their Psychic- and Dragon-type moves.

deepseatooth.description: An item to be held by Clamperl. This fang gleams a sharp silver and boosts Clamperl’s Sp. Atk stat.

deepseascale.description: An item to be held by Clamperl. This scale shines with a faint pink and boosts Clamperl’s Sp. Def stat.

smokeball.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It enables the holder to flee from any wild Pokémon encounter without fail.

everstone.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. A Pokémon holding this peculiar stone is prevented from evolving.

focusband.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. When the holder is hit with a move that should knock it out, it may be able to endure with 1 HP.

luckyegg.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It’s an egg filled with happiness that earns the holder extra Exp. Points.

scopelens.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It’s a lens for scoping out weak points. It boosts the holder’s critical-hit ratio.

potion.description: A spray-type medicine for treating wounds. It can be used to restore 20 HP to a Pokémon.

antidote.description: A spray-type medicine for treating poisoning. It can be used to lift the effects of being poisoned from a Pokémon.

burnheal.description: A spray-type medicine for treating burns. It can be used to cure a Pokémon suffering from a burn.

iceheal.description: A spray-type medicine for treating freezing. It can be used to thaw out a Pokémon that has been frozen solid.

awakening.description: A spray-type medicine to wake the sleeping. It can be used to rouse a Pokémon from the clutches of sleep.

paralyzeheal.description: A spray-type medicine for treating paralysis. It can be used to free a Pokémon that has been paralyzed.

fullrestore.description: A medicine that can be used to fully restore the max HP of a Pokémon and cure any status condition it may have.

maxpotion.description: A spray-type medicine for treating wounds. It can be used to fully restore the max HP of a Pokémon.

hyperpotion.description: A spray-type medicine for treating wounds. It can be used to restore 120 HP to a Pokémon.

superpotion.description: A spray-type medicine for treating wounds. It can be used to restore 60 HP to a Pokémon.

fullheal.description: A spray-type medicine that is broadly effective. It can be used to cure any status condition a Pokémon may have.

revive.description: A medicine that can be used to revive a Pokémon that has fainted. It also restores half the Pokémon’s max HP.

maxrevive.description: A medicine that can be used to revive a Pokémon that has fainted. It also fully restores the Pokémon’s max HP.

freshwater.description: Water with high mineral content. It can be used to restore 30 HP to a Pokémon.

sodapop.description: A highly carbonated soda drink. It can be used to restore 50 HP to a Pokémon.

lemonade.description: A very sweet and refreshing drink. It can be used to restore 70 HP to a Pokémon.

moomoomilk.description: A bottle of highly nutritious milk. It can be used to restore 100 HP to a Pokémon.

energypowder.description: A very bitter medicinal powder. It can be used to restore 60 HP to a Pokémon.

energyroot.description: A very bitter medicinal root. It can be used to restore 120 HP to a Pokémon.

healpowder.description: A very bitter medicinal powder. It can be used to cure any status condition a Pokémon may have.

ether.description: A medicine that can be used to restore 10 PP to a single move that a Pokémon knows.

maxether.description: A medicine that can be used to fully restore the max PP of a single move that a Pokémon knows.

maxelixir.description: A medicine that can be used to fully restore the max PP of all four moves that a Pokémon knows.

lavacookie.description: Lavaridge Town’s local specialty. It can be used to cure any status condition a Pokémon may have.

tm01.description: The user focuses its mind before launching a punch. This move fails if the user is hit before it is used.

tm02.description: The user slashes the target with huge sharp claws.

tm03.description: The user attacks the target with a pulsing blast of water. This may also confuse the target.

tm04.description: The user quietly focuses its mind and calms its spirit to raise its Sp. Atk and Sp. Def stats.

tm05.description: The target is scared off, and a different Pokémon is dragged out. In the wild, this ends a battle against a single Pokémon.

tm06.description: A move that leaves the target badly poisoned. Its poison damage worsens every turn.

tm07.description: The user summons a hailstorm lasting five turns. It damages all Pokémon except Ice types.

tm08.description: The user tenses its muscles to bulk up its body, raising both its Attack and Defense stats.

tm09.description: The user forcefully shoots seeds at the target two to five times in a row.

tm10.description: The user is roused, and its Attack and Sp. Atk stats increase.

tm11.description: The user intensifies the sun for five turns, powering up Fire-type moves. It lowers the power of Water-type moves.

tm12.description: The target is taunted into a rage that allows it to use only attack moves for three turns.

tm13.description: The target is struck with an icy-cold beam of energy. This may also leave the target frozen.

tm14.description: A howling blizzard is summoned to strike opposing Pokémon. This may also leave the opposing Pokémon frozen.

tm15.description: The target is attacked with a powerful beam. The user can’t move on the next turn.

tm16.description: A wondrous wall of light is put up to reduce damage from special attacks for five turns.

tm17.description: This move enables the user to protect itself from all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

tm18.description: The user summons a heavy rain that falls for five turns, powering up Water-type moves. It lowers the power of Fire-type moves.

tm19.description: A nutrient-draining attack. The user’s HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.

tm20.description: The user creates a protective field that prevents status conditions for five turns.

tm21.description: The user damages opposing Pokémon by emitting a powerful flash.

tm22.description: In this two-turn attack, the user gathers light, then blasts a bundled beam on the next turn.

tm23.description: The target is slammed with a steel-hard tail. This may also lower the target’s Defense stat.

tm24.description: A strong electric blast crashes down on the target. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

tm25.description: A wicked thunderbolt is dropped on the target to inflict damage. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

tm26.description: The user sets off an earthquake that strikes every Pokémon around it.

tm27.description: The user makes a swift attack on the target’s legs, which lowers the target’s Speed stat.

tm28.description: The user burrows into the ground, then attacks on the next turn. It can also be used to exit dungeons.

tm29.description: The target is hit by a strong telekinetic force. This may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.

tm30.description: The user hurls a shadowy blob at the target. This may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.

tm31.description: The user attacks with a swift chop. It can also break barriers, such as Light Screen and Reflect.

tm32.description: By moving rapidly, the user makes illusory copies of itself to raise its evasiveness.

tm33.description: A wondrous wall of light is put up to reduce damage from physical attacks for five turns.

tm34.description: The user strikes the target with a quick jolt of electricity. This attack never misses.

tm35.description: The target is scorched with an intense blast of fire. This may also leave the target with a burn.

tm36.description: Unsanitary sludge is hurled at the target. This may also poison the target.

tm37.description: A five-turn sandstorm is summoned to hurt all combatants except Rock, Ground, and Steel types. It raises the Sp. Def stat of Rock types.

tm38.description: The target is attacked with an intense blast of all-consuming fire. This may also leave the target with a burn.

tm39.description: Boulders are hurled at the target. This also lowers the target’s Speed stat by preventing its movement.

tm40.description: The user confounds the target with speed, then slashes. This attack never misses.

tm41.description: The user torments and enrages the target, making it incapable of using the same move twice in a row.

tm42.description: This attack move doubles its power if the user is poisoned, burned, or paralyzed.

tm43.description: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

tm44.description: The user goes to sleep for two turns. This fully restores the user’s HP and heals any status conditions.

tm45.description: If it is the opposite gender of the user, the target becomes infatuated and less likely to attack.

tm46.description: The user attacks and steals the target’s held item simultaneously. The user can’t steal anything if it already holds an item.

tm47.description: The target is hit with wings of steel. This may also raise the user’s Defense stat.

tm48.description: The user employs its psychic power to exchange Abilities with the target.

tm49.description: The user shoots boiling hot water at its target. This may also leave the target with a burn.

tm50.description: The user attacks the target at full power. The attack’s recoil harshly lowers the user’s Sp. Atk stat.

tm51.description: The user lands and rests its body. This move restores the user’s HP by up to half of its max HP.

tm52.description: The user heightens its mental focus and unleashes its power. This may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.

tm53.description: The user draws power from nature and fires it at the target. This may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.

tm54.description: A restrained attack that prevents the target from fainting. The target is left with at least 1 HP.

tm55.description: If the target’s HP is half or less, this attack will hit with double the power.

tm56.description: The user flings its held item at the target to attack. This move’s power and effects depend on the item.

tm57.description: The user attacks the target with an electric charge. The user may use any remaining electricity to raise its Sp. Atk stat.

tm58.description: The user endures any attack with at least 1 HP. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

tm59.description: The target is attacked with a shock wave generated by the user’s gaping mouth.

tm60.description: An energy-draining punch. The user’s HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.

tm61.description: The user shoots a sinister flame at the target to inflict a burn.

tm62.description: The user generates a damaging sound wave by vibration. This may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.

tm63.description: The user stimulates its brain by thinking bad thoughts. This sharply raises the user’s Sp. Atk stat.

tm64.description: The user attacks everything around it by causing a tremendous explosion. The user faints upon using this move.

tm65.description: The user slashes with a sharp claw made from shadows. Critical hits land more easily.

tm66.description: The user stores power, then attacks. If the user moves after the target, this attack’s power will be doubled.

tm67.description: The user recycles a held item that has been used in battle so it can be used again.

tm68.description: The user charges at the target using every bit of its power. The user can’t move on the next turn.

tm69.description: The user polishes its body to reduce drag. This sharply raises the Speed stat.

tm70.description: The user flashes a light that lowers the target’s accuracy. It can also be used to illuminate caves.

tm71.description: The user stabs the target from below with sharpened stones. Critical hits land more easily.

tm72.description: The power of this attack move is doubled if the user has been hurt by the target in the same turn.

tm73.description: The user launches a weak jolt of electricity that paralyzes the target.

tm74.description: The user tackles the target with a high-speed spin. The slower the user compared to the target, the greater the move’s power.

tm75.description: A frenetic dance to uplift the fighting spirit. This sharply raises the user’s Attack stat.

tm76.description: The user lays a trap of levitating stones around the opposing team. The trap hurts opposing Pokémon that switch into battle.

tm77.description: The user hypnotizes itself into copying any stat change made by the target.

tm78.description: The user yells as if it’s ranting about something, which lowers the Sp. Atk stats of opposing Pokémon.

tm79.description: The user releases a horrible aura imbued with dark thoughts. This may also make the target flinch.

tm80.description: Large boulders are hurled at opposing Pokémon to inflict damage. This may also make the opposing Pokémon flinch.

tm81.description: The user slashes at the target by crossing its scythes or claws as if they were a pair of scissors.

tm82.description: While it is asleep, the user randomly uses one of the moves it knows.

tm83.description: The user strikes everything around it by stomping down on the ground. This lowers the Speed stats of those hit.

tm84.description: The target is stabbed with a tentacle, arm, or the like steeped in poison. This may also poison the target.

tm85.description: The user eats the dreams of a sleeping target. The user’s HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.

tm86.description: The user snares the target with grass and trips it. The heavier the target, the greater the move’s power.

tm87.description: The user enrages and confuses the target. However, this also sharply raises the target’s Attack stat.

tm88.description: The user pecks the target. If the target is holding a Berry, the user eats it and gains its effect.

tm89.description: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

tm90.description: The user creates a substitute for itself using some of its HP. The substitute serves as the user’s decoy.

tm91.description: The user gathers all its light energy and releases it all at once. This may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.

tm92.description: The user creates a bizarre area in which slower Pokémon get to move first for five turns.

medalbox.description: A box-shaped machine that stores Medals and Medal information.

permit.description: A permit that is needed to enter the Nature Preserve, a place that not many people know about.

ovalcharm.description: Having one of these mysterious oval charms makes it more likely Pokémon Eggs might be found during picnics.

shinycharm.description: Having one of these mysterious shining charms makes it more likely you’ll encounter Shiny Pokémon in the wild.

plasmacard.description: A card key needed to enter the password inside the Plasma Frigate.

grubbyhanky.description: A handkerchief dropped by a regular at Nacrene City’s Café Warehouse. It smells faintly like a Pokémon.

colressmachine.description: A special device that wrings out the potential of Pokémon. It’s an imperfect prototype.

revealglass.description: A mysterious looking glass that reveals the truth. It can return a Pokémon to its original shape.

discountcoupon.description: This special coupon allows you to buy items at a discount when you are shopping at a boutique.

strangesouvenir.description: An ornament depicting a mysterious Pokémon that has been venerated as a guardian deity for an extremely long time in the Alola region.

adventurerules.description: This book contains all the points a new Trainer needs to know on a journey. It was handmade by a kind friend.
adventurerules.source: Let’s Go, Pikachu! / Let’s Go, Eevee!

elevatorkey.description: A card key that activates the elevator in Lysandre Labs. It is emblazoned with Team Flare’s logo.

honorofkalos.description: A precious symbol that is awarded to individuals who have done great things for the Kalos region.

intriguingstone.description: A rather curious stone that might appear valuable to some. It’s all in the eye of the beholder.

lenscase.description: A rather chic-looking case for carrying contact lenses.

lookerticket.description: A ticket that was handmade by Looker. It’s decorated with a liberal amount of glittery paint.

megaring.description: This ring contains an unknown power that somehow enables a Pokémon carrying a Mega Stone to Mega Evolve in battle.

powerplantpass.description: This pass serves as an ID card for gaining access to the Power Plant that lies along Route 13.

profsletter.description: A letter that Professor Sycamore wrote to your mother. A faint but pleasant perfume seems to cling to the paper.

rollerskates.description: Attaches roller skates to the bottom of your shoes, allowing you to glide quickly around and perform tricks.

sprinklotad.description: A watering can shaped like a Lotad. It helps promote the healthy growth of any Berries planted in good, soft soil.

tmvpass.description: A commuter pass that allows the holder to ride the TMV between Lumiose City and Kiloude City at any time.

tm96.description: The target is slugged with a punch thrown at maximum power. It’s also one of the Pokétch’s hidden moves.

tm97.description: A strong wind blows away the target’s barriers, such as Reflect or Light Screen, and lowers their evasiveness. It’s also one of the Pokétch’s hidden moves.

tm98.description: The user attacks with a punch that may lower the target’s Defense stat. It’s also one of the Pokétch’s hidden moves.

tm99.description: The user charges at the target and may make it flinch. It’s also one of the Pokétch’s hidden moves.

tm100.description: The user tells the target a secret, and the target loses its ability to concentrate. This lowers the target’s Sp. Atk stat.

commonstone.description: A perfectly normal stone that might appear to be valuable to some. It’s all in the eye of the beholder.

traveltrunk.description: A light and yet incredibly effective trunk, which can contain every last piece of clothing that can be bought.

shaloursable.description: Shalour City’s famous shortbread. It can be used to cure any status condition a Pokémon may have.

megacharm.description: This charm contains an unknown power that somehow enables a Pokémon carrying a Mega Stone to Mega Evolve in battle.

megaglove.description: This glove contains an unknown power that somehow enables a Pokémon carrying a Mega Stone to Mega Evolve in battle.

devonparts.description: A case that contains mechanical parts of some sort made by the Devon Corporation.

pokeblockkit.description: A set containing a Berry Blender for making Pokéblocks and a Pokéblock Case for storing Pokéblocks.

keytoroom1.description: A key that opens a door inside Sea Mauville.

keytoroom2.description: A key that opens a door inside Sea Mauville.

keytoroom4.description: A key that opens a door inside Sea Mauville.

keytoroom6.description: A key that opens a door inside Sea Mauville.

devonscubagear.description: A device made by Devon Corporation that provides oxygen to users during the use of Dive.

magmasuit.description: A suit made with the collective technological know-how of Team Magma. It can withstand any impact.

aquasuit.description: A suit made with the collective technological know-how of Team Aqua. It can withstand any impact.

pairoftickets.description: Tickets for two to the astronomical show being held at the Mossdeep Space Center.

megabracelet.description: This bracelet contains an unknown power that somehow enables a Pokémon carrying a Mega Stone to Mega Evolve in battle.

megapendant.description: This necklace contains an unknown power that somehow enables a Pokémon carrying a Mega Stone to Mega Evolve in battle.

megaglasses.description: These glasses contain an unknown power that somehow enables a Pokémon carrying a Mega Stone to Mega Evolve in battle.

megaanchor.description: This anchor contains an unknown power that somehow enables a Pokémon carrying a Mega Stone to Mega Evolve in battle.

megastickpin.description: This stickpin contains an unknown power that somehow enables a Pokémon carrying a Mega Stone to Mega Evolve in battle.

megatiara.description: This tiara contains an unknown power that somehow enables a Pokémon carrying a Mega Stone to Mega Evolve in battle.

megaanklet.description: This anklet contains an unknown power that somehow enables a Pokémon carrying a Mega Stone to Mega Evolve in battle.

megacuff.description: This cuff contains an unknown power that somehow enables a Pokémon carrying a Mega Stone to Mega Evolve in battle.

prisonbottle.description: A bottle believed to have been used to seal away the power of a certain Pokémon long, long ago.

keystone.description: A stone filled with an unexplained power. It makes Pokémon that battle with a Mega Stone Mega Evolve.

meteoriteshard.description: One of the fragments of a meteorite from Granite Cave. It’s faintly warm to the touch.

eonflute.description: A flute that can be used to summon Latios or Latias no matter where you are.

zring.description: A mysterious ring that enables Pokémon to use Z-Power. It requires both the willpower and the physical power of the Trainer wearing it.

professorsmask.description: The mask that belongs to The Masked Royal. This pro wrestler apparently sews his mask on a machine himself.

festivalticket.description: A ticket that allows you to host a mission in Festival Plaza.

sparklingstone.description: A stone entrusted to you by a Pokémon that has been venerated as a guardian deity in the Alola region. There is said to be some secret in how it sparkles.

zygardecube.description: An item in which Zygarde Cores and Cells are gathered. You can also use it to change Zygarde’s forms.

ridepager.description: By entering certain numbers on this pager, you can summon Ride Pokémon in an instant.

sunflute.description: It is said that the tones it produces were offered up as an expression of gratitude to the Legendary Pokémon of the sun.

moonflute.description: It is said that the tones it produces were offered up as an expression of gratitude to the Legendary Pokémon of the moon.

enigmaticcard.description: A mysterious card. Written on it is a request that you go to a guest room in the motel on Akala Island’s Route 8.

zpowerring.description: A mysterious ring that enables Pokémon to use Z-Power. It requires both the willpower and the physical power of the Trainer wearing it.

pinkpetal.description: A pressed flower petal you receive from Mina during Mina’s trial. The goal is to collect seven different kinds of petals.

orangepetal.description: A pressed flower petal you receive from Ilima during Mina’s trial. The goal is to collect seven different kinds of petals.

bluepetal.description: A pressed flower petal you receive from Lana during Mina’s trial. The goal is to collect seven different kinds of petals.

redpetal.description: A pressed flower petal you receive from Kiawe during Mina’s trial. The goal is to collect seven different kinds of petals.

greenpetal.description: A pressed flower petal you receive from Mallow during Mina’s trial. The goal is to collect seven different kinds of petals.

yellowpetal.description: A pressed flower petal you receive from Sophocles during Mina’s trial. The goal is to collect seven different kinds of petals.

purplepetal.description: A pressed flower petal you receive from Nanu during Mina’s trial. The goal is to collect seven different kinds of petals.

rainbowflower.description: A flower made of the petals you received from captains. It’s proof that your growth has been recognized by them.

surgebadge.description: A novelty badge that you can receive at the Kantonian Gym. Rumor has it that it imitates the Badge of a Gym somewhere.

ilimasnormaliumz.description: The Normalium Z you were entrusted with by Ilima. You were asked to place it on the pedestal at the back of Verdant Cavern.

leftpokeball.description: A Poké Ball containing a Pokémon that lost its Trainer. It seems the Trainer hails from Ula’ula Island.

rotohatch.description: One of the Rotom Powers. When used, it helps Eggs hatch faster.

rotobargain.description: One of the Rotom Powers. When used, it reduces the prices of products at Poké Marts by half.

rotoprizemoney.description: One of the Rotom Powers. When used, it triples the prize money you receive after battle.

rotoexppoints.description: One of the Rotom Powers. When used, it slightly increases the Exp. Points your Pokémon receive after battle.

rotofriendship.description: One of the Rotom Powers. When used, it helps Pokémon in your party grow friendly quite a lot faster.

rotoencounter.description: One of the Rotom Powers. When used, it increases the chance of encountering high-level wild Pokémon for a certain period of time.

rotostealth.description: One of the Rotom Powers. When used, it prevents you from encountering any wild Pokémon for a certain period of time.

rotohprestore.description: One of the Rotom Powers. When used, it fully restores the max HP of your battling Pokémon.

rotopprestore.description: One of the Rotom Powers. When used, it fully restores the max PP of your battling Pokémon.

rotoboost.description: One of the Rotom Powers. When used, it boosts all stats for your battling Pokémon.

rotocatch.description: One of the Rotom Powers. When used, it makes you far likelier to succeed at catching the wild Pokémon in the immediate area.

autograph.description: The autograph you got from the Vermilion City Gym Leader, Lt. Surge. He wrote, “Good luck!”

pokemonbox.source: Let’s Go, Pikachu! / Let’s Go, Eevee!

clothingtrunk.description: A very light trunk that can carry clothing for you and your Pokémon.

silverrazzberry.description: A Berry that makes it easier to catch Pokémon when given to them.

goldenrazzberry.description: A Berry that makes it drastically easier to catch Pokémon when given to them.

silvernanabberry.description: A Berry that calms Pokémon you’re trying to catch when given to them.

goldennanabberry.description: A Berry that drastically calms Pokémon you’re trying to catch when given to them.

silverpinapberry.description: A Berry that makes you more likely to get an item when given to Pokémon you’re trying to catch.

goldenpinapberry.description: A Berry that makes you drastically more likely to get an item when given to Pokémon you’re trying to catch.

endorsement.description: A letter of recommendation that you’ll need in order to participate in the Gym Challenge.

wishingstar.description: A stone found in the Galar region with a mysterious power. It’s said that your dreams come true if you find one.

dynamaxband.description: A Wishing Star has been affixed to it. It lets out a light that allows Pokémon to Dynamax when at a Power Spot.

campinggear.description: Everything you need to set up a tent and get cooking in a Wild Area or at a camping spot.

hitechearbuds.description: Strange earbuds that allow you to freely control the volume of various sounds.

catchingcharm.description: Having one of these mysterious, unshakable charms makes it more likely you’ll get a critical catch.

oldletter.description: A letter entrusted to you by a girl, to be delivered to a boy. Strangely, it looks old to you.

bandautograph.description: It’s signed by all members of the Galar region’s most charismatic band, the Maximizers.

soniasbook.description: Professor Sonia’s published writings. Her new discoveries about the Galar region’s legends are recorded in this enjoyable read.

rotomcatalog.description: A catalog of devices that Rotom like. Use the catalog to have Rotom hop in and out of the various devices listed within.

stylecard.description: Having one of these cards increases the selection available to you in boutiques and hair salons.

armorpass.description: A pass to go to the Isle of Armor. Show it to the rail staff at Wedgehurst Station.

expcharm.description: Having one of these charms increases the Exp. Points your Pokémon get. It’s a strange, stretchy charm that encourages growth.

markcharm.description: Having one of these mysterious and unique charms makes it more likely you’ll encounter a Pokémon with a mark.

legendaryclue1.description: A clue about the King of Bountiful Harvests. It’s written by Peony, and an old photo is attached to it.

legendaryclue2.description: A clue about the legend of giants. It’s written by Peony and has unique drawings.

legendaryclue3.description: A clue about the legend of bird Pokémon. It’s written by Peony and has a unique drawing.

crownpass.description: A pass to go to the Crown Tundra. Show it to the rail staff at Wedgehurst Station.

woodencrown.description: A mysterious object made of wood. Part of it seems to be chipped. Maybe it’s meant to be part of something.

radiantpetal.description: A single petal that the King of Bountiful Harvests gave you. It radiates faint light.

whitemanehair.description: Mane hair that belonged to the King of Bountiful Harvests’ beloved steed, Glastrier. The hair is strong and very flexible.

blackmanehair.description: Mane hair that belonged to the King of Bountiful Harvests’ beloved steed, Spectrier. The hair is very smooth to the touch.

icerootcarrot.description: Produce that the King of Bountiful Harvests’ beloved steed likes to eat. It grew in a field covered in snow.

shaderootcarrot.description: Produce that the King of Bountiful Harvests’ beloved steed likes to eat. It grew in a gloomy field.

dyniteore.description: Mysterious ore that can be obtained in the Max Lair. Something good will happen if you give it to a collector in the Crown Tundra.

carrotseeds.description: Seeds to plant in a field. The kind of carrot you’ll get is determined by which field you plant the seeds in.

abilitypatch.description: A patch that can be used to change the regular Ability of a Pokémon to a rarer Ability.

legendplate.description: A stone tablet imbued with the essence of all creation. When used on a certain Pokémon, it allows that Pokémon to gain the power of every type there is.

rotomphone.description: The latest model of smartphone. A Pokémon called Rotom lives within it, and it can be used to run all sorts of handy apps.

sandwich.description: A dish made by sandwiching vegetables, meat, or other ingredients between two pieces of bread. It makes a fantastic meal when out on a picnic.

koraidonspokeball.description: A Poké Ball that can hold the mysterious Pokémon known as Koraidon. A boy named Arven gave it to you.

miraidonspokeball.description: A Poké Ball that can hold the mysterious Pokémon known as Miraidon. A boy named Arven gave it to you.

teraorb.description: An orb that holds within it the power to crystallize. When it is charged with energy, it can be used to cause Pokémon to Terastallize.

scarletbook.description: A record of the expedition that the author, Heath, went on within the Great Crater of Paldea. The book has the name “Sada” written on it in clumsy handwriting.

violetbook.description: A record of the expedition that the author, Heath, went on within the Great Crater of Paldea. The book has the name “Turo” written on it in clumsy handwriting.

kofuswallet.description: A wallet that was left behind by Kofu, the Gym Leader at the Cascarrafa Gym. You’re to deliver it to him at the market in Porto Marinada.

tinybambooshoot.description: A small and rare bamboo shoot. It’s quite popular with a certain class of gourmands.

bigbambooshoot.description: A large and rare bamboo shoot. It’s extremely popular with a certain class of gourmands.

scrollofdarkness.description: A peculiar scroll that can make a certain species of Pokémon evolve. Written upon it are the true secrets of the path of darkness.

scrollofwaters.description: A peculiar scroll that can make a certain species of Pokémon evolve. Written upon it are the true secrets of the path of water.

rotostick.description: A stick to rest a Rotom Phone on. It allows you to take selfies from a little bit farther away than you could on your own.

tealstylecard.description: Having one of these cards increases the selection available to you in boutiques and hair salons.

tealmask.description: A teal mask patterned after the face of an ogre. Ogerpon dropped it while fleeing up the stairs after visiting the Festival of Masks.

glimmeringcharm.description: Having one of these mysterious glimmering charms increases the number of Tera Shards you receive from Tera Raid Battles.

crystalcluster.description: A cluster of the crystals found within the Crystal Pool. They sparkle brilliantly and are apparently necessary to repair a certain mask.

reinsofunity.description: Reins that people presented to the king. They enhance Calyrex’s power over bountiful harvests and unite Calyrex with its beloved steed.

picnicset.description: A roomy basket packed with all sorts of things for use when enjoying picnicking with your Pokémon.

academybottle.description: A bottle emblazoned with the academy’s emblem. It’s light, sturdy, and vacuum insulated, so it’ll keep your hots hot and your colds cold.

polkadotbottle.description: A polka-dot-patterned bottle that’s small, light, and even comes with a cup. The detachable strap makes it handy for walking around with.

stripedbottle.description: A striped bottle that’s small, light, and even comes with a cup. The detachable strap makes it handy for walking around with.

diamondbottle.description: A diamond-patterned bottle that’s small, light, and even comes with a cup. The detachable strap makes it handy for walking around with.

academycup.description: The academy’s standard-issue cup for picnicking. The careful design of its mouth makes it popular both inside and outside the academy.

stripedcup.description: A cup for kids to use at picnics. It’s made of light but strong material. It’s stackable, which makes it handy for carrying around.

polkadotcup.description: A cup for kids to use at picnics. It’s made of light but strong material. It’s stackable, which makes it handy for carrying around.

flowerpatterncup.description: A cup for kids to use at picnics. It’s made of light but strong material. It’s stackable, which makes it handy for carrying around.

academytablecloth.description: The academy’s standard-issue tablecloth. It’s made with the latest fiber-processing technology and is so tough that not even a Razor Claw can tear it.

whimsicaltablecloth.description: A tablecloth made in collaboration with a popular picture-book author. The gently drawn Pokémon make even the loveliest picnic table more charming.

leafytablecloth.description: A botanically themed tablecloth featuring Grass-type Pokémon. Can you find the Pokémon that doesn’t quite fit in?

spookytablecloth.description: A pop-art-style tablecloth with Pokémon faces floating up from the deep nighttime blue. This is a must-have for fans of Ghost types.

academyball.description: The academy’s standard-issue ball in a regulation size. Lots of students believe that if you kick it right on the academy emblem, it’ll fly in a straight line.

marillball.description: A Marill-themed ball. It’s soft and springy. Make sure you haven’t mistaken a real Marill for this ball before throwing.

yarnball.description: A small ball of yarn. It’s woven tight so as not to unravel, but even if it were to come undone, at least you could still use the yarn for something.

cyberball.description: A ball themed after hardcore gaming PCs. It may not light up like its inspiration, but it still stands out.

goldpick.description: A golden pick that oozes class. Using it on a sandwich lends an extravagant air that’ll make you want to eat up, even if you don’t love the fillings.

silverpick.description: A silver pick that oozes class. Using it on a sandwich lends an extravagant air that’ll make you want to eat up, even if you don’t love the fillings.

redflagpick.description: This pick flies a red flag that lends an air of adventure. The flag itself is made of card stock, so it’ll fly proudly even with no wind.

blueflagpick.description: This pick flies a blue flag that lends an air of adventure. The flag itself is made of card stock, so it’ll fly proudly even with no wind.

pikapikapick.description: A Pick-achu, as it were, sporting Pikachu’s usual expression. It’s easy to grab by the ears, which is part of why it’s so popular.

winkingpikapick.description: A Pick-achu, if you will, sporting Pikachu’s winking face. It’s easy to grab by the ears, which is part of why it’s so popular.

veeveepick.description: A pick designed after Eevee, sporting the Pokémon’s usual expression. It’s easy to grab by the ears, which is part of why it’s so popular.

smilingveepick.description: A pick designed after Eevee, sporting the Pokémon’s smiling face. It’s easy to grab by the ears, which is part of why it’s so popular.

bluepokeballpick.description: A sandwich pick with a simple blue Poké Ball design. Often used by Trainers who picked a Water-type Pokémon for their first partner.

steelbottleb.description: A go-to bottle sometimes used while camping. The stainless steel keeps the temperature inside steady, making it great for keeping drinks hot or cold.

silverbottle.description: A popular option among hikers. It’s made with titanium, so it doesn’t rust even if it’s used to hold drinks with high sodium content.

plaidtableclothr.description: A sturdy tablecloth made of thick fabric. The quietly composed red plaid gives the table some flair.

bwgrasstablecloth.description: A tablecloth with a fun, trendy black-and-white design featuring Pokémon that seem poised to leap from the tall grass at any moment.

battletablecloth.description: A garish, eye-catching tablecloth. Putting this on your picnic table will inspire any person or Pokémon who eats there to do their best.

redpokeballpick.description: A sandwich pick with a simple red Poké Ball design. Often used by Trainers who picked a Fire-type Pokémon for their first partner.

partysparklerpick.description: This pick features a small sparkler that goes off automatically. It’s used at parties or for guests of honor. It leaves an oddly appealing aroma once it’s burned out.

heroicswordpick.description: A pick made to be the coolest. Once you’ve eaten, you can pretend you’re a hero of legend. Souvenir shops at tourist spots sell these for some reason.

magicalstarpick.description: A pick shaped after a magic wand. Perhaps the real magic is the food maker’s wish for a delicious dish.

magicalheartpick.description: A pick shaped after a magic wand. Perhaps the real magic is the food maker’s wish for a delicious dish.

sunsetflowerpick.description: A flower pick designed to evoke a blazing sunset. It’s part of a line of “sky-flower” picks. Using a few is guaranteed to boost that special picnic spirit.

sunriseflowerpick.description: A flower pick designed to evoke a glorious sunrise. It’s part of a line of “sky-flower” picks. Using a few is guaranteed to boost that special picnic spirit.

bluedish.description: A dish for picnics. Comes in plenty of colors to choose from based on the food or the mood. The blue variety is a consistent strong seller.

greendish.description: A dish for picnics. Comes in plenty of colors to choose from based on the food or the mood. The green variety is quite popular.

orangedish.description: A dish for picnics. Comes in plenty of colors to choose from based on the food or the mood. The orange variety is the most popular of all.

reddish.description: A dish for picnics. Comes in plenty of colors to choose from based on the food or the mood. The red variety never fails to sell well.

whitedish.description: A dish for picnics. Comes in plenty of colors to choose from based on the food or the mood. The white variety comes recommended by sellers.

yellowdish.description: A dish for picnics. Comes in plenty of colors to choose from based on the food or the mood. The yellow variety is impossible to go wrong with.

tr00.description: A frenetic dance to uplift the fighting spirit. This sharply raises the user’s Attack stat.

tr01.description: The user drops onto the target with its full body weight. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

tr02.description: The target is scorched with an intense blast of fire. This may also leave the target with a burn.

tr03.description: The target is blasted by a huge volume of water launched under great pressure.

tr04.description: The user attacks everything around it by swamping its surroundings with a giant wave.

tr05.description: The target is struck with an icy-cold beam of energy. This may also leave the target frozen.

tr06.description: A howling blizzard is summoned to strike opposing Pokémon. This may also leave the opposing Pokémon frozen.

tr07.description: A powerful low kick that makes the target fall over. The heavier the target, the greater the move’s power.

tr08.description: A strong electric blast crashes down on the target. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

tr09.description: A wicked thunderbolt is dropped on the target to inflict damage. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

tr10.description: The user sets off an earthquake that strikes every Pokémon around it.

tr11.description: The target is hit by a strong telekinetic force. This may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.

tr12.description: The user relaxes and lightens its body to move faster. This sharply raises the Speed stat.

tr13.description: The user takes a deep breath and focuses so that critical hits land more easily.

tr14.description: The user waggles a finger and stimulates its brain into randomly using nearly any move.

tr15.description: The target is attacked with an intense blast of all-consuming fire. This may also leave the target with a burn.

tr16.description: The user charges at the target and may make it flinch.

tr17.description: The user temporarily empties its mind to forget its concerns. This sharply raises the user’s Sp. Def stat.

tr18.description: The user drains the target’s blood. The user’s HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.

tr19.description: The user strikes with a simultaneous three-beam attack. This may also burn, freeze, or paralyze the target.

tr20.description: The user creates a substitute for itself using some of its own HP. The substitute serves as the user’s decoy.

tr21.description: An all-out attack that becomes more powerful the less HP the user has.

tr22.description: Unsanitary sludge is hurled at the target. This may also poison the target.

tr23.description: The user lays a trap of spikes at the opposing team’s feet. The trap hurts Pokémon that switch into battle.

tr24.description: The user rampages and attacks for two to three turns. The user then becomes confused.

tr25.description: The user materializes an odd psychic wave to attack the target. This attack does physical damage.

tr26.description: The user endures any attack with at least 1 HP. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

tr27.description: While it is asleep, the user randomly uses one of the moves it knows.

tr28.description: Using its tough and impressive horn, the user rams into the target with no letup.

tr29.description: The user switches places with a party Pokémon in waiting and passes along any stat changes.

tr30.description: The user compels the target to keep using the move it encored for three turns.

tr31.description: The target is slammed with a steel-hard tail. This may also lower the target’s Defense stat.

tr32.description: The user crunches up the target with sharp fangs. This may also lower the target’s Defense stat.

tr33.description: The user hurls a shadowy blob at the target. This may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.

tr34.description: Two turns after this move is used, a hunk of psychic energy attacks the target.

tr35.description: The user attacks in an uproar for three turns. During that time, no Pokémon can fall asleep.

tr36.description: The user attacks by exhaling hot breath on opposing Pokémon. This may also leave those Pokémon with a burn.

tr37.description: The target is taunted into a rage that allows it to use only attack moves for three turns.

tr38.description: The user catches the target off guard and swaps its held item with its own.

tr39.description: The user attacks the target with great power. However, this also lowers the user’s Attack and Defense stats.

tr40.description: The user employs its psychic power to exchange Abilities with the target.

tr41.description: The user launches a kick that lands a critical hit more easily. This may also leave the target with a burn.

tr42.description: The user lets loose a horribly echoing shout with the power to inflict damage.

tr43.description: The user attacks the target at full power. The attack’s recoil harshly lowers the user’s Sp. Atk stat.

tr44.description: The user absorbs a mystical power from space to raise its Defense and Sp. Def stats.

tr45.description: The user attacks by shooting muddy water at opposing Pokémon. This may also lower their accuracy.

tr46.description: The user hardens its body’s surface like iron, sharply raising its Defense stat.

tr47.description: The user slashes the target with huge sharp claws.

tr48.description: The user tenses its muscles to bulk up its body, raising both its Attack and Defense stats.

tr49.description: The user quietly focuses its mind and calms its spirit to raise its Sp. Atk and Sp. Def stats.

tr50.description: The user handles a sharp leaf like a sword and attacks by cutting its target. Critical hits land more easily.

tr51.description: The user vigorously performs a mystic, powerful dance that raises its Attack and Speed stats.

tr52.description: The user tackles the target with a high-speed spin. The slower the user compared to the target, the greater the move’s power.

tr53.description: The user fights the target up close without guarding itself. This also lowers the user’s Defense and Sp. Def stats.

tr54.description: The user lays a trap of poison spikes at the feet of the opposing team. The spikes will poison opposing Pokémon that switch into battle.

tr55.description: The user cloaks itself in fire and charges the target. This also damages the user quite a lot. This attack may leave the target with a burn.

tr56.description: The user lets loose a blast of aura power from deep within its body at the target. This attack never misses.

tr57.description: The target is stabbed with a tentacle, arm, or the like steeped in poison. This may also poison the target.

tr58.description: The user releases a horrible aura imbued with dark thoughts. This may also make the target flinch.

tr59.description: The user slams a barrage of hard-shelled seeds down on the target from above.

tr60.description: The user slashes at the target by crossing its scythes or claws as if they were a pair of scissors.

tr61.description: The user generates a damaging sound wave by vibration. This may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.

tr62.description: The target is attacked with a shock wave generated by the user’s gaping mouth.

tr63.description: The user attacks with a ray of light that sparkles as if it were made of gemstones.

tr64.description: The user heightens its mental focus and unleashes its power. This may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.

tr65.description: The user draws power from nature and fires it at the target. This may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.

tr66.description: The user tucks in its wings and charges from a low altitude. This also damages the user quite a lot.

tr67.description: The user makes the ground under the target erupt with power. This may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.

tr68.description: The user stimulates its brain by thinking bad thoughts. This sharply raises the user’s Sp. Atk stat.

tr69.description: The user focuses its willpower to its head and attacks the target. This may also make the target flinch.

tr70.description: The user gathers all its light energy and releases it all at once. This may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.

tr71.description: The user whips up a storm of leaves around the target. The attack’s recoil harshly lowers the user’s Sp. Atk stat.

tr72.description: The user violently whirls its vines, tentacles, or the like to harshly lash the target.

tr73.description: The user shoots filthy garbage at the target to attack. This may also poison the target.

tr74.description: The user slams the target with its steel-hard head. This may also make the target flinch.

tr75.description: The user stabs the target from below with sharpened stones. Critical hits land more easily.

tr76.description: The user lays a trap of levitating stones around the opposing team. The trap hurts opposing Pokémon that switch into battle.

tr77.description: The user snares the target with grass and trips it. The heavier the target, the greater the move’s power.

tr78.description: The user strikes everything around it by swamping the area with a giant sludge wave. This may also poison those hit.

tr79.description: The user slams into the target with its heavy body. The more the user outweighs the target, the greater the move’s power.

tr80.description: The user hurls an electric orb at the target. The faster the user is than the target, the greater the move’s power.

tr81.description: The user turns the target’s power against it. The higher the target’s Attack stat, the greater the damage it deals.

tr82.description: The user attacks the target with stored power. The more the user’s stats are raised, the greater the move’s power.

tr83.description: The user teleports using a strange power and switches places with one of its allies.

tr84.description: The user shoots boiling hot water at its target. This may also leave the target with a burn.

tr85.description: The user is roused, and its Attack and Sp. Atk stats increase.

tr86.description: The user shrouds itself in electricity and smashes into its target. This also damages the user a little.

tr87.description: The user crashes into its target while rotating its body like a drill. Critical hits land more easily.

tr88.description: The user slams its target with its flame-covered body. The more the user outweighs the target, the greater the move’s power.

tr89.description: The user attacks by wrapping its opponent in a fierce wind that flies up into the sky. This may also confuse the target.

tr90.description: The user plays rough with the target and attacks it. This may also lower the target’s Attack stat.

tr91.description: Opposing Pokémon are drenched in an odd poisonous liquid. This lowers the Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed stats of a poisoned target.

tr92.description: The user damages opposing Pokémon by emitting a powerful flash.

tr93.description: The user swings both arms and hits the target. The target’s stat changes don’t affect this attack’s damage.

tr94.description: The user fiercely attacks the target using its entire body.

tr95.description: The user attacks the target’s throat, and the resultant suffering prevents the target from using moves that emit sound for two turns.

tr96.description: The user attacks the enemy with a pollen puff that explodes. If the target is an ally, it gives the ally a pollen puff that restores its HP instead.

tr97.description: The user bites the target with its psychic capabilities. This can also destroy Light Screen and Reflect.

tr98.description: The user slams into the target using a full-force blast of water. This may also lower the target’s Defense stat.

tr99.description: The user attacks by slamming its body into the target. The higher the user’s Defense, the more damage it can inflict on the target.

tm00.description: The target is slugged by a punch thrown with muscle-packed power.
